title: Naringenin as a Potent Natural Biofilm Inhibitor of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in Diabetic Foot Ulcers Through lasR Competitive Inhibition.
authors: Warrier, Anjali; Satyamoorthy, Kapaettu; Murali, Thokur Sreepathy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柚皮素通过竞争性抑制LasR蛋白（细菌群体感应受体）抑制铜绿假单胞菌生物膜，涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Chronic non-healing foot ulcers are a major complication in diabetic patients, contributing to significant morbidity and mortality. Microorganisms in these wounds form biofilms, conferring greater virulence and enhanced protection from antibiotics. Hence, we examined naringenin, and other natural compounds like chlorofuranone, 4-nitropyridine N-oxide, and quercetin as a positive control against the major pathogenic organism that forms biofilm in foot ulcers. Here, we focused on Pseudomonas aeruginosa, which produces high levels of biofilm in diabetic foot ulcers. Naringenin (47.10 microg/ml for PA21; 124.7 microg/ml for PA333) and other natural compounds were tested for their ability to inhibit biofilm formation and virulence in vitro, and their effect on biofilm-associated gene expression was studied. The biofilm inhibitory mechanism of naringenin was elucidated using in silico analysis and in vitro reporter gene assay. In vitro biofilm assays, confocal and scanning electron microscopy showed that natural compounds effectively inhibited biofilm, without causing cell death. Treatment with these compounds significantly altered the expression of genes associated with quorum sensing in P. aeruginosa, such as lasR, pslA, algA, gacS, and pelA. Naringenin decreased the production of major virulence factors in P. aeruginosa. Molecular docking showed that naringenin exhibited the strongest binding affinity to LasR, and the same was validated by reporter gene assay using plasmid pSB1142 indicating its role as a competitive inhibitor in the las quorum sensing system in P. aeruginosa. The findings of this study could be extrapolated to in vivo diabetic wound infection models to help optimize the use of naringenin in effective biofilm control for better wound management in diabetic patients.
abstract_zh: 慢性不愈合足部溃疡是糖尿病患者的主要并发症，导致显著的发病率和死亡率。这些伤口中的微生物形成生物膜 (biofilm)，赋予更强的毒力并增强对抗生素的保护作用。因此，我们检测了柚皮素 (naringenin) 及其他天然化合物，如氯呋喃酮 (chlorofuranone)、4-硝基吡啶N-氧化物 (4-nitropyridine N-oxide) 和槲皮素 (quercetin) 作为阳性对照，针对足部溃疡中形成生物膜的主要病原体。在此，我们聚焦于铜绿假单胞菌 (Pseudomonas aeruginosa)，其在糖尿病足溃疡中产生高水平的生物膜。测试了柚皮素（PA21为47.10微克/毫升；PA333为124.7微克/毫升）及其他天然化合物抑制生物膜形成和体外毒力的能力，并研究了它们对生物膜相关基因表达的影响。通过计算机模拟分析和体外报告基因测定阐明了柚皮素的生物膜抑制机制。体外生物膜测定、共聚焦和扫描电子显微镜显示，天然化合物有效抑制生物膜，而不引起细胞死亡。这些化合物的处理显著改变了铜绿假单胞菌中群体感应 (quorum sensing) 相关基因的表达，如lasR、pslA、algA、gacS和pelA。柚皮素降低了铜绿假单胞菌主要毒力因子的产生。分子对接 (molecular docking) 显示柚皮素对LasR表现出最强的结合亲和力，并通过使用质粒pSB1142的报告基因测定得到验证，表明其在铜绿假单胞菌的las群体感应系统中作为竞争性抑制剂发挥作用。本研究的发现可外推至体内糖尿病伤口感染模型，有助于优化柚皮素在有效生物膜控制中的应用，以改善糖尿病患者的伤口管理。
